about: ANCA TX7 tool and cutter grinder, self-made in Blender (sources/tcgrind/build_tcgrind.py) from dealer photos of the TX7 / TX7+ (kdmachinery.com, IndiaMART product image, Liberty Machinery listings) and the record's specs, replacing the GrabCAD block model (6,160 triangles, no colours) that read as a box; the library keeps that model, and this one is in its frame. The slate-blue flared base, the cream faceted enclosure with the big amber window on its left chamfer and a second on its front, the sliding door with two tall angled windows on its rails, the stainless rail lettered TX7+, the blue right-hand column with the ANCA logotype, the charcoal pendant (lit LCD, keyboard, jog knob, e-stop), the signal tower, the raised rear hood; inside, the wheel head with its wheel pack and the workhead holding an end-mill blank; behind, the electrical cabinet and the oil / filtration unit with its filter, pump and mist extractor ducted to the hood.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: modelled against dealer photos; look sheets and three.js before/after checked

source.made: self-made in Blender from public dimensions and photos; build script and .blend beside it

tcgrind_cream.about: ANCA's cream enclosure panels, the door, the wheel head cover, the pendant's keys

tcgrind_blue.about: ANCA slate blue: the flared base, the right-hand column, the cabinets behind, the coolant line

tcgrind_dark.about: charcoal: the pendant housing, the ANCA logotype, vents, grinding wheels

tcgrind_red.about: the red TX7+ lettering, the e-stop, the door button, the tower's red

tcgrind_glass.about: the windows: polycarbonate tinted amber by oil mist, alpha-blended

double_sided_why: self-made closed solids, normals checked outward when built (jig.orient), hidden faces culled: single-sided saves fill rate
sources_used: the record (5 axes, 8 in wheels, max tool 8 in x 15.75 in, 36.5 kW spindle) and its library model's box (2354.6 x 1917.6 x 2243 mm), whose part layout placed the door, the pendant and the units behind

dealer and product photos of the ANCA TX7 / TX7+ found by image search (kdmachinery.com 'Used Anca TX7 Plus 8073310', IndiaMART, Liberty Machinery): colours, the faceted cream enclosure, amber windows, the blue column with the ANCA logotype and pendant

unsure.what: the units behind (electrical cabinet, oil / filtration with mist extractor) fill the library model's rear blocks; their shapes are plausible, not photographed
the enclosure's facets are simplified to one big chamfer and a sloped top front; the real TX7+ has more panel breaks
